## Ready for PR — diary release gates

Required before a PR that ships the diary undo / re-log surface (ideas 37 / 32 / 31 / 16 / 9) may merge.

The three release gates are defined once, in the single source of truth,
[`docs/release-checklist.md`](docs/release-checklist.md). The gates are owner-attested,
not CI-enforced, and are **not** restated here — this checklist points at the doc
instead of duplicating the gate list.

- [ ] Release gates checked against [`docs/release-checklist.md`](docs/release-checklist.md).

- [ ] Owner attestation: the PR author / owner attests that gates (a), (b) and (c) are green, quoting the doc in this PR.
